items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Then in May of 1951, Conrad Janis, Dick Smith, Tom Sharpstein, Danny Barker was playing guitar... Do you remember that date in New York? [INTERVIEWEE] Mmm-hmm. Yes.

ctx.x: Now, in this Circle record, there was a medley of the three marches. You had "Bugle Boy" and there's "Gettysburg" and "1919." These marches were done in the old march spirit. But the others were rather Modern Dixieland, sort of. Was this a style that you enjoyed playing?

Yes. That band sounded more like a New Orleans band. It sounded more like a New Orleans band, to get... Especially the way the trumpet player and the clarinet player, he... He had a style of his own, Sharpstein.
